entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [API Proposal]: SymbolFinder.FindReferencesAsync overload that selects the inheritance cascade #86614
  • SymbolFinder.FindReferencesAsync should not throw when a project has an UnresolvedAnalyzerReference #86613
  • Do not indent a `switch` section if it is enclosed in a block #86612
  • Spurious CS8655 when an awaited union switch is deconstructed #86608
  • Add structural `ShebangDirectiveTriviaSyntax.Content` construction APIs #86606
    18.15

Closed

  • IDE0100 is reported for a comparison that performs a user-defined conversion to bool; the fix breaks the build or changes behavior #86479
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-12423.212 #86605
  • Unexpected error is reported for a delegate creation of off an extension block method #86458
    18.14

PullRequests

Created

  • Document inference dependency breaking change #86617
    Area-Compilers
  • Align signature checks performed for `SynthesizedUnionCtor` with those performed for methods declared explicitly in source. #86616
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Handle UnresolvedAnalyzerReference when computing a project checksum #86615
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Support generating explicit ToString/PrintMembers for records #86611
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Fixed type inference in base primary constructor #86610
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Prevent fail fast in tests that aborts the test process #86609
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Fix behavior of ShebangDirectiveTriviaSyntax.Content #86607
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Run File
  • Support assemblies without location in scripting (single-file apps) #86604
    Area-Interactive, Community
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #86603
    Area-Infrastructure

Merged

  • Do not report IDE0100 when the comparison performs a user-defined implicit conversion to bool #86596
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode, Next
  • Align behavior of `SourceNamedTypeSymbol.ReduceExtensionMember` with `ReducedExtensionMethodSymbol.InferExtensionMethodTypeArguments` with respect to type argument handling #86563
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Use Key Vault signing for the PR tagger #86448
    Area-IDE, Community, Next

Updated

  • Let F# Find All References results carry pre-classified line text #85281
    Area-IDE, Community
  • Rank and highlight F# Navigate To results like C# and VB #85280
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3145044 #86598
    Area-Razor
  • Support multithreaded ProjectData slice writes #86433
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Unsafe evolution: fix unsafe expression diagnostics #86292
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Inline arrays: disallow capture with address-of #86325
    Area-Compilers
  • Make scripting work in single-file deployments #57910
    Area-Interactive, Community
  • Caching compiler: replay diagnostics #86263
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Caching Compiler
  • Remove the unsafe v2 stackalloc/SkipLocalsInit restriction #86294
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Stop scanning preceding siblings in SyntaxNavigator.GetNextToken/GetPreviousToken #86352
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Make the generated MSBuild editorconfig path-independent (opt-in) #84669
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode
